name: react-three/gpu-pathtracer
category: A9. Adjacent resources mentioned during discovery
role: Progressive GPU path tracing for R3F scenes via three-gpu-pathtracer
summary: R3F wrapper over three-gpu-pathtracer: a WebGL path tracer that accumulates samples on a canvas until a sample count is reached. Driven by React props (samples, frames, reset) inside an R3F scene; output is a converged still or a noisy progressive frame. Strength is physically based lighting inside the browser stack.
use_when: Path-traced stills of an existing R3F scene where a browser-only pipeline is required
avoid_when: Production ray-traced frames: Blender Cycles is faster, supported and scriptable

assessment.rationale: Version 0.3.2, last published July 2025, pre-1.0 with a small repo. Needs a GPU-backed browser and converge-time waiting; Blender Cycles and POV-Ray (both catalogued) give path-traced frames with proper CLI routes.

notes: 2026-10-26: commit dates not shown by fetched page; README props table contradicts itself on minSamples default.
